name: Muapi
summary: Hosted Muapi MCP for generative media and selected data research. Search SEO, lead-enrichment, social-read, market-data and web-research APIs, estimate USD costs, and submit capped data lookups. Paid calls and media generation can consume Muapi credits. Grant only the tools each agent needs.
publisher: Muapi by Vadoo Internet Services Private Limited
license: Proprietary service; see Muapi Terms of Service
setup_instructions: Create an API key at https://muapi.ai/access-keys. In Suparagent, connect this listing and save the key as its bearer token. Grant only the individual tools each agent needs. For data research, muapi_data_api_search finds supported endpoints and their input fields and prices; muapi_data_api_estimate returns a current quote; muapi_data_api_call submits one selected lookup and requires max_cost_usd. The call checks a fresh USD quote and refuses submission above that cap, but an approved call can spend Muapi credits. Poll an asynchronous request with muapi_predict_result. The data tools exclude social publishing and sandbox control. The MCP also provides generation, credit top-ups, and API-key management; grant those only when needed. Do not paste the bearer key into chat or a tool argument.
test_instructions: Grant muapi_data_api_search to an agent and search for a read-only task such as public backlinks or company enrichment. This lists supported inputs and price metadata without submitting a paid request. You can grant muapi_data_api_estimate to obtain a current quote for a selected endpoint. Only if you intentionally want to run a paid lookup, grant muapi_data_api_call, review the exact arguments in Suparagent's approval card, and set max_cost_usd to the maximum you approve; the call may spend credits. Remove any grants the agent does not need.
